title: Critter Lob
summary: Creature bodies: round critters (blobs on gf-blob-1, procedural motion) lob seeds and grab berries; each seat a different critter.

verified.how: node bin/gamesfun.mjs create <dir> --from critter-lob, then node builder/tools/verify.mjs <dir> (a build verify, every build measure; 180 s) under gpu-run.sh on Linux with a desktop GPU (CHROME_ARGS="--use-gl=angle --use-angle=gl-egl"), with the looks pilot's private pack on the machine (its three rigged critters in the three seats)
